notes: SPALACEToken (src/SPALACEToken.sol) is a fixed-supply, fee-free ERC-20 with a parameterless constructor, so constructorArgs is empty. The constructor mints exactly 1,000,000,000 * 10^18 = 1e27 units once to msg.sender (the launch factory) and nothing can mint afterwards: there is no owner, no admin function, no mint, burn, pause, blacklist or upgrade interface, and name, symbol, decimals and totalSupply are compile-time constants. Transfers are plain ERC-20 transfers with no fee, tax or limit, so flows to and from the factory, the Merkle distributor and the Uniswap v4 PoolManager move exactly what they say. The factory, not the token, sends the swarm's 10% through its Merkle distributor, seeds the pool from the deployer balance and forwards any remainder to remainderTo. No application contracts are deployed. The declared initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, totalSupply and the deployed currency ordering.
